name: week
title: Risk week
subtitle: Fictional demo data until you import your own register

sections.title: Breached or due now
sections.note: Rule findings with the rule cited. docs/compliance.md has the source for each.
sections.sql: select rule,reference,finding from compliance_findings where severity=1 order by rule,reference

sections.title: Open incidents and notice clocks
sections.sql: select reference,title,severity,owner,days_open,to_char(cps230_42_due_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as apra_24h_due,to_char(cps230_33_due_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as apra_72h_due,ndb_assess_by from incident_queue order by aware_at

sections.title: Overdue actions
sections.sql: select record,reference,title,owner,due_on,days_left from action_queue where days_left<0 order by due_on

sections.title: Reviews and control tests due
sections.sql: select 'review' as what,reference,title,owner,next_review_on as due_on from risk_register where status='open' and (next_review_on is null or next_review_on<=current_date+7) union all select 'control test',risk||'/'||reference,title,owner,next_test_on from control_queue where next_test_on<=current_date+7 order by due_on nulls first

name: register
title: Risk register
subtitle: Open risks by residual rating, against appetite

sections.title: Over appetite
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,residual_score as residual,appetite_score as appetite,open_actions,overdue_actions from risk_register where over_appetite order by residual_score desc

sections.title: Every open risk
sections.sql: select reference,title,category,owner,inherent_score as inherent,residual_score as residual,rating,next_review_on,weak_controls,open_actions from risk_register order by residual_score desc,reference

name: resilience
title: Operational resilience
subtitle: Critical operations, tolerance levels and material service providers

sections.title: Critical operations
sections.sql: select reference,name,owner,max_outage_hours,max_data_loss_hours,last_exercise_on,bcp_reviewed_on from critical_operations order by reference

sections.title: Material service providers
sections.sql: select p.reference,p.name,p.service,o.reference as operation,p.agreement_changed_on,p.regulator_notified_on,p.last_reviewed_on from service_providers p left join critical_operations o on o.id=p.critical_operation_id where p.material and p.status='active' order by p.reference
